# PART 10 — INDIAN MINERALS & ENERGY

**UPPCS Priority: 🔴 VERY HIGH**

This is the **Ratta Booklet** for Indian Minerals & Energy. Focus on **mineral → type → major state → important belt → associated minerals → mines/fields → energy source → power projects → renewable energy → UP-specific resources**.

No common traps, PYQ connections or self-test.

# 1. 🇮🇳 INDIA — MINERAL RESOURCE BASICS

India has significant reserves/resources of:

> **Coal**

> **Iron ore**

> **Manganese**

> **Bauxite**

> **Mica**

> **Limestone**

> **Chromite**

> **Copper**

> **Lead–Zinc**

> **Gold**

> **Uranium**

> **Thorium**

### 🔥 MASTER

> **Eastern & central India → Major mineral belt**

> **Peninsular Plateau → Metallic minerals**

---

# 2. ⛏️ CLASSIFICATION OF MINERALS

Two broad groups:

### Metallic minerals

Contain:

> Metals.

Examples:

> Iron ore

> Manganese

> Bauxite

> Copper

> Gold

> Chromite.

### Non-metallic minerals

Examples:

> Mica

> Limestone

> Gypsum

> Dolomite

> Graphite.

### 🔴

> **Metallic → Iron/Copper/Gold/Bauxite**

> **Non-metallic → Mica/Limestone/Gypsum**

---

Major:

> **Ferrous → Iron + Manganese + Chromite**

# 5. ⛓️ IRON ORE

Main types:

> **Hematite**

> **Magnetite**

> Limonite

> Siderite.

Most important Indian ores:

> **Hematite + Magnetite**

---

# 6. 🔴 HEMATITE

Chemical composition:

> **Fe₂O₃**

Characteristics:

> High iron content.

Major Indian deposits:

> Odisha

> Jharkhand

> Chhattisgarh

> Karnataka

> Goa.

### 🔴

> **Hematite → Fe₂O₃**

---

# 7. 🧲 MAGNETITE

Chemical composition:

> **Fe₃O₄**

Characteristics:

> Magnetic.

Generally:

> Very high iron content.

Major regions:

> Karnataka

> Andhra Pradesh

> Goa

> Tamil Nadu.

### 🔴

> **Magnetite → Fe₃O₄ → Magnetic**

> Copper + lead-zinc + gypsum + limestone + lignite.

# 100. 🏭 MINERAL-BASED INDUSTRY — LOCATION LOGIC

### Iron & Steel

Needs:

> Iron ore + coking coal + limestone.

Therefore:

> Major plants often located near raw-material belts or transport corridors.

### Aluminium

Needs:

> Bauxite + abundant electricity.

### Cement

Needs:

> Limestone + energy + gypsum.
